name: Ball drop compare
what: Two glowing circles with a label under each, on a dark ground: a small ball drops onto the left one, dips it and bounces away off the side of the frame, then a second ball drops into the right one, which flashes and sends two rings outward.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f6-f30 a ball falls onto the left circle (slow start, accelerating, stretching with its speed); f30 the circle dips and the ball bounces off to the left, gone by f52; f72-f110 a second ball falls onto the right circle (a little slower); f110-f131 that circle flashes and two rings spread out and fade; then it holds (the reference's corner logo is left out)

tracks.name: bounce
tracks.what: the ball bounces off to the left and out of the frame; the left circle dips

tracks.name: ripple
tracks.what: the right circle flashes and two rings spread out and fade
